lines.en: I am a stele that walks.
Each step of mine cracks the ground.
Originium grows out of my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的身体像凿过的石头。
lines.en: My body is like carved stone.

lines.zh: 我拖着沉重的底座前行。
lines.en: I drag my heavy base forward.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方留下晶尘。
lines.en: Crystal dust lies where I have trodden.

lines.zh: 碑面上的纹路会亮一下。
lines.en: The carvings on my face flicker bright.
I turn slowly toward whatever lives.
Brick grinds in my joints.
I do not go around. I break through.
My shadow is wider than a wall.

lines.zh: 鸟在我靠近前就飞走了。
lines.en: The birds leave before I arrive.
I stand like a monument.

lines.zh: 源石在我体内缓慢生长。
lines.en: Originium grows slowly inside me.
No one can read the marks on my face.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，压着这片地。
lines.en: I hold still, weighing down this ground.
The air around me turns dry.
I listen to the gravel under me.
My edges are sharp.
I wait for someone to read me.

lines.zh: 一块碎晶从我身上落下。
lines.en: A shard of crystal falls from me.
My breathing sounds like stones rubbing.
You stand before the stele and look up.
I have recorded your shape.

lines.zh: 来的人，都留在了这块地上。
lines.en: All who came stayed in this ground.
Your name will not be carved here.
Originium is drawing near you.

lines.zh: 我立在这里，就是为了挡。
lines.en: I stand here precisely to block.
That iron of yours is no use against me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起了半边身子。
lines.en: I have raised half of myself slowly.

lines.zh: 我在衡量你值不值得动。
lines.en: I weigh whether you are worth moving for.
Step back and the stele remains a stele.
A piece of stone has cracked.
Crystal dust falls from me.
I stand there like a monument.
A new line is scored on my face.
I feel no pain. I only record.
Originium seeps out at the break.
I tilt my bulk slightly.
Debris scatters on the ground.
My broken edges are sharper now.
You struck the stele. The stele will remember.
You bring an offering to the stele.
I do not eat. I only take.
This offering is too light.

lines.zh: 我这座碑立着，源石在脚下铺开。
lines.en: As I stand, originium spreads at my base.

lines.zh: 我身上的源石对它没兴趣。
lines.en: The originium in me takes no interest.
Put it down, but not on my plinth.
I glance at it and turn away again.
What do you want in exchange? Say it plainly.
A stele does not eat; it remembers.
Take it away. Do not foul this ground.
My body is harder than a stele.
I did not move; you bounced off.
One of my edges caught you.
You push against me and go nowhere.
Crystal dust shakes from my seams.
That one hurt you, not me.
I shifted half an inch and righted myself.
The base is heavy; it does not move.

lines.zh: 你的骨头比我的石头软。
lines.en: Your bones are softer than my stone.
Hit it again and it will hurt more.
I will not walk with you.
A stele stands in one place only.
If you would pay respects, kneel.

lines.zh: 我记着每一个靠近的人。
lines.en: I remember everyone who comes near.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边站着，也算位置。
lines.en: Standing beside me counts as a place.
We do not stand side by side; we face each other.

lines.zh: 你走了，我会记得你的脚步。
lines.en: When you leave, I will remember your steps.
This place has no need of two steles.
Stay here and I stay quiet.
The ground before the stele is empty.
I press it under my base.
I take it and it crumbles.
There is my dust on it.
I lever it up with an edge.
It dropped into a seam of my stone.
This is heavy. Good for weighing down ground.
I set it straight.
Whoever dropped it, I do not ask.
The originium has stained it a little.
Leave it here and it will grow into the soil.
You have entered the stele's range.
I have lifted my whole mass.
My shadow already covers you.
Originium grows toward you.
I have waited long enough for this.

lines.zh: 我的身量把光全挡住了。
lines.en: My bulk blocks out the light.
When the stele falls, the ground gives way.

lines.zh: 你喘息的声音，我记住了。
lines.en: I have learned the sound of your breathing.
I press toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 碑面开始发亮，就是信号。
lines.en: My face brightens. That is the signal.
There is nowhere for you to stand.
This is not a fight. It is a record.
I mean to press you into the earth.
A stele does not tire. People do.
One step from my plinth remains.
Now — the whole stele comes down.
My steps pack the ground flat.

lines.zh: 砖石响，你就知道我近了。
lines.en: Stone grinds, and you know I am near.

lines.zh: 你往哪边退，我都跟着转。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, I turn to follow.

lines.zh: 我等的就是你脚下一滑。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to slip.
Originium grains roll along with me.
You are in the stele's shadow and cannot leave it.

lines.zh: 我举起半边身体，慢慢来。
lines.en: I raise half my body, taking my time.
I shift my weight to the leading edge.
Listen — the cracks in the ground creak.

lines.zh: 刻着字的石碑，一步一响。
lines.en: The inscribed stone rings with each step.
The edge of the stele faces you.
Your raised shield is very clear to me.
I turn my bulk slowly sideways.
This ground has become my plinth.

lines.zh: 你避开了第一次，还有第二次。
lines.en: You avoided the first. There is a second.
My edges do not dull.
When your back meets the wall, it is done.
Originium grows, and I wait.
The harder you breathe, the closer I come.

lines.zh: 碑身落下的时候没有声音。
lines.en: When the stele falls, there is no sound.
I bring my whole mass down.
A patch of ground has caved in.
My edge rakes across your shoulder.
The impact leaves you unable to stand.
Originium fragments splash over you.
I lift slowly and press down again.
You have been forced into a crack.

lines.zh: 我的重击把你按进土里。
lines.en: My blow drives you into the dirt.
I turn my bulk and you meet an edge.
Dust rises from the ground.
I pin your leg.
You push, but a stele does not yield.

lines.zh: 碑面亮了，那是最后一记。
lines.en: My face flares. That is the last blow.

lines.zh: 你动着，我就再加一分重。
lines.en: Keep moving and I add another measure of weight.

lines.zh: 我退了半寸，只是换角度。
lines.en: I withdrew half an inch, only to change angle.
You did not move. Then it is over.
Weight is my weapon.
I press you down into my shadow.
The ground has been pressed flat.

lines.zh: 碑还是立着，你已经倒了。
lines.en: The stele still stands; you have fallen.
The stele rises slowly from the ground.

lines.zh: 源石在土里长成了一座碑。
lines.en: Originium has grown into a stele in the soil.

lines.zh: 我先露出碑顶，然后是碑身。
lines.en: First the top shows, then the body.

lines.zh: 裂缝从碑座向四周散开。
lines.en: Cracks spread outward from my base.
The gravel on the ground begins to tremble.

lines.zh: 我立在这里，很久没动过。
lines.en: I have stood here and not moved in a long while.

lines.zh: 碑面上的刻痕亮了一下。
lines.en: The carvings on my face flicker once.
There is a smell of stone in the air.

lines.zh: 我挪动时，土墙塌了半边。
lines.en: When I shifted, half an earthen wall collapsed.
The open ground before the stele is mine.
I set one foot down first.
This stele has begun to walk.

lines.zh: 火烧不穿石头，只留下黑印。
lines.en: Fire cannot pierce stone; it only leaves a black mark.

lines.zh: 碑身砸在地上，裂得更深。
lines.en: My bulk hits the ground and cracks deeper.

lines.zh: 水从碑缝里灌进去，很重。
lines.en: Water forces into my seams, and I grow heavy.
The blast broke off one of my corners.

lines.zh: 有东西钉在碑面上，进不去。
lines.en: Something stuck on my face and went no further.

lines.zh: 碑上的字亮了一瞬，又暗了。
lines.en: The marks on me flare once, then dim.

lines.zh: 源石在吞噬我，我没有食。
lines.en: Originium consumes me; I have no food.
Lightning strikes my crown and stone falls away.

lines.zh: 碑座下面是虚的，我往下坠。
lines.en: The plinth rests on nothing, and I fall.
